verdict.rationale: The only webhook mention is a pricing-page line, "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks," which describes webhooks as triggers for workflow automation. It does not document registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a consumer can subscribe to for Glama events. No event types, endpoint registration, payloads, or webhook API are evidenced, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. That makes this adjacent workflow-trigger support, not delivery of event-subscription webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
